name: External_Entity
title: External Entity (Interacting System / Actor)
desc: Represents external systems, third parties, or users that send/receive data across system perimeters.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="90" viewBox="0 0 160 90">
  <rect x="5" y="5" width="150" height="80" rx="4" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="80" y="48" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">External Entity</text>
</svg>

name: Process
title: Process / Execution Task
desc: Represents a single computation, application, microservice, or OT control loop process.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120">
  <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="54" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="60" y="62" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#14532d" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">Process</text>
</svg>

name: Multi_Process
title: Multi-Process / Subsystem
desc: Represents complex distributed processes or multi-threaded service subsystems.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120">
  <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="54" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="46" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="60" y="62" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#14532d" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">Multi-Process</text>
</svg>

name: Data_Store
title: Data Store / Historian / DB
desc: Represents at-rest data storage (Historian DB, configuration repository, event log).
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="100" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
  <line x1="5" y1="15" x2="155" y2="15" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="5" y1="85" x2="155" y2="85" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="5" y="15" width="150" height="70" fill="#eff6ff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <text x="80" y="52" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1e3a8a" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">Data Store</text>
</svg>

name: Data_Flow_Unidirectional
title: Data Flow (Unidirectional)
desc: Represents single-direction data flow (e.g. telemetry egress via Data Diode).
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="60" viewBox="0 0 200 60">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#ef4444"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  <line x1="15" y1="30" x2="185" y2="30" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="100" y="20" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#991b1b" text-anchor="middle">Data Flow (Unidirectional)</text>
</svg>

name: Data_Flow_Bidirectional
title: Data Flow (Bidirectional)
desc: Represents two-way interactive protocol communication (Modbus TCP, BACnet, HTTP/REST).
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="60" viewBox="0 0 200 60">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow-bi" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#ef4444"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  <line x1="15" y1="30" x2="185" y2="30" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" marker-start="url(#arrow-bi)" marker-end="url(#arrow-bi)"/>
  <text x="100" y="20" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#991b1b" text-anchor="middle">Bidirectional Flow</text>
</svg>

name: Trust_Boundary_Box
title: Trust Boundary Zone Perimeter
desc: Represents a security perimeter / IEC 62443 security zone boundary.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="260" height="140" viewBox="0 0 260 140">
  <rect x="5" y="5" width="250" height="130" rx="8" fill="rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.04)" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>
  <text x="18" y="24" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#dc2626">Trust Boundary / Zone</text>
</svg>

name: AND_Gate
title: Attack Tree AND Gate
desc: Indicates that all child attack conditions must be fulfilled for node compromise.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="90" height="80" viewBox="0 0 90 80">
  <path d="M 15 65 L 15 35 Q 15 15 45 15 Q 75 15 75 35 L 75 65 Z" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="45" y="48" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">AND</text>
</svg>

name: OR_Gate
title: Attack Tree OR Gate
desc: Indicates that any child attack condition is sufficient for node compromise.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="90" height="80" viewBox="0 0 90 80">
  <path d="M 15 65 Q 45 55 75 65 L 75 35 Q 75 15 45 15 Q 15 15 15 35 Z" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="45" y="46" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">OR</text>
</svg>

name: Leaf_Node
title: Attack Tree Leaf Node (Exploit Action)
desc: Atomic attacker action or specific vulnerability exploit vector.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="60" viewBox="0 0 120 60">
  <rect x="5" y="5" width="110" height="50" rx="3" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="60" y="34" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Leaf Action</text>
</svg>

name: Asset_Label_A01
title: Asset Token Label (A01)
desc: Standardized token identifier for tracked assets.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="70" height="35" viewBox="0 0 70 35">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="66" height="31" rx="4" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="35" y="21" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#854d0e" text-anchor="middle">A01</text>
</svg>

name: Security_Control_Label_C01
title: Security Control Token Label (C01)
desc: Standardized token identifier for compensating security controls.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="70" height="35" viewBox="0 0 70 35">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="66" height="31" rx="4" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="35" y="21" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">C01</text>
</svg>

name: Threat_Actor_Label_TA01
title: Threat Actor Token Label (TA01)
desc: Standardized token identifier for threat actor profiles.
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="70" height="35" viewBox="0 0 70 35">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="66" height="31" rx="4" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="35" y="21" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#991b1b" text-anchor="middle">TA01</text>
</svg>
